profile.dividendPolicy: The Company has a policy to pay dividend at a rate of not less than 40 percent of the net profit from the Company's separated financial statements after deducting corporate income tax and any reserves as required by laws and as determined in the Company's Article of Associations.The dividend payment may be lower than the abovementioned rate taking into account the various factors, including economic conditions, the Company's performance, financial position, cash flow, working capital, investment and business expansion plan, liabilities, conditions, and limitations according to the loan agreement and other factors as appropriate which the board of directors of the Company will carefully consider. The annual dividend payment must be approved by the shareholders' meeting, except for interim dividends, which the Company's board of directors may approve from time to time if they deem that the Company has sufficient profits and the Company will report such dividend payment to the next shareholders' meeting. In this regard, the dividend payment of the Company must comply with the laws and the Company's Article of Associations.
